batting.name: SE Marsh
batting.dismissal: st WP Saha b DJ Hussey

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b AB Dinda

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: st WP Saha b Mohammad Hafeez

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b Umar Gul

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b S Sreesanth

batting.name: DB Das
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b S Sreesanth

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c JR Hopes b Gagandeep Singh

balls.text: make that 21 from the over! Chawla, not for the first time, backs away to leg and swings hard, connecting well and slashing the ball over backward point and it keeps on going
excellent batting! Chawla walks miles across and connects superbly with the paddle from outside off stump, collecting the low full toss into the gap at short fine leg
again its a length ball and Chawla, stepping away, swings this over mid-on
and again, he steps aside and has a free swing, hitting this one past midwicket for four more, Ishant trying to bowl length
bang, thats four! Frees his arms and slogs downtown, where the fielder dives over the ball, good hitting this from Chawla
goes for a slog across the line, misses, ball clubs him in the midriff and he runs a leg-bye

oh ho, a quick low, low full toss outside leg stump, Chawla again backs away and gets cramped going for a big flick, his head goes one way, bat the other (it looks like he misread it and thought it was a beamer) and survives with an inside-edge
yorker on middle and leg, he backs away and just manages to get bat down on ball, scooting it through his legs to square leg, classical bowling this
backs away, Gul slips in a full toss, Chawla drives to point for one
leg stump goes for a walk, Sangakkara exposing all three sticks and trying one of those paddle-scoops to fine leg but Gul pitches very full and straight and hits his mark
and that's four, as he again makes room and flashes the bat at it, slicing over backward point to beat the fielder running around in the deep
slower ball, full on off stump, he backs away and square-drives one

good ball but a better shot, a front-foot push with a very straight bat back past Sangakkara, and that single raises the 150 for Punjab, much to the home crowd's delight ... 'Panga na lo' starts blaring across the PCA Stadium
gets his back leg across and square-drives this one down to third man
walks right across to try and scoop the ball over square leg but the slower yorker length outside off stump beats his bat
fuller length, he flicks and inside-edges down to short fine leg
well done, Pathan backing away and pulling the length ball into the gap over square leg and there's no one out there to stop that
first he oversteps, then he bowls a full toss, Sangakkara walks right across the stumps and paddles it to backward square leg, so we see a free hit
good length on about leg stump and Pathan on-drives a smart single
slapped! Gul pitches too short and Sangakkara gets into position to jab that away very flat over midwicket for another boundary
back of a length outside leg stump, tucked off the hips for a single
bouncer this time, he walks across to leg and steers up and over for one

dropped! Another slice of luck for Sangakkara, who pulls in the air down to long-on, where the fielder runs across, dives forward, but misses completely to allow four as well ... would have been a stunner but he mistimed his dive
back of a length, he gets back and pushes softly to cover for one
wide, sliding down leg stump and past the attempted flick
back of a length outside leg, tucked towards midwicket this time
too short and he works it across the line past midwicket, again running hard but this time Ishant gets down properly and fires in a good throw
dances down and drives aerial to wide midwicket, running hard
tossed up outside off stump, Pathan comes forward and pushes to cover
full and flatter, sliding down leg stump, flicked past midwicket and mid-on and a poor piece of fielding on the ropes from Ishant gives away four, sloppy
slower through the air and Sangakkara chips it down to long-on
flat ball on the stumps, he skips down and drives to midwicket
short, he pulls from outside off into the ground to midwicket
dead straight shot, just getting to the pitch and driving past Sangakkara and the stumps, long-off fields
well stopped, as Sangakkara drives to point, who dives and saves runs, then fumbles as he gets up, batsmen decide to take one and just make it
fuller length on leg stump, he tries to flick but gets a thick inside-edge onto the pads, Sangakkara urges the single and they get it towards backward point
short of a length, Sangakkara waits and opens the face, running through gully for another single down to third man
fuller length and Pathan comes onto the front foot, pushing sweetly into the gap between cover and point for a single
bouncer just outside off stump, very high and its called wide duly
quicker, flatter, and he works it across the line to midwicket
flat on off stump, Pathan gets well forward and defends
tossed up again, spins away and beats the bat and it evades Saha and slip, Ganguly stands there and blinks and Hussey doesn't look too impressed

good throw! Hodge tosses it up invitingly, Goel goes for a booming drive, misses, it flies past Saha and slip towards short third man, the nonstriker calls for a single but Goel is slow to get back and flat throw is accepted by Hodge
tight stuff, looped up on a length and he taps it back cautiously
full outside off, he uses the feet and drives past backward point
pitches just around leg and swings down, Goel shuffles across and flicks, Gul appeals but thats a leg-bye into the gap at short fine leg
short of a length and angled across Pathan, who opens his account with a dab into the gap at gully for a single to third man
short one again, he too is cramped and hurried into the shot, pulling awkwardly to midwicket but the ball drops safely and dribbles to the man there
tight again, this one on the stumps and its driven to point
beaten on a nothing shot, just driving from the crease but the ball, 142ks, lifts up at some height and leaves him fishing, well bowled Gul
and he wastes no time! Begins with a short one which gains on Jayawardene, cramped going for the pull shot, getting the toe end of the bat on it and it balloons straight to Ganguly at midwicket
fired in faster, he again shapes to work it away but the ball slips away of the edge wide of short third man and the fielder runs down to haul it back in but loses that race
a touch flatter, outside off, he shapes to flick but cannot connect
tossed up outside off, he strides forward and runs it Gul at gully

stumped him! Hussey moves around the stumps to the left-hander, cleverly tossing it up into the rough outside off stump, and Marsh skips down in an attempt to heave it over mid-on but misses completely for Saha to take care of the rest, so the change works well
quicker and flatter, he gets across and works it to point
and he's welcomed with a six over cow corner, as Jayawardene kneels down and launches Hussey into the night, the ball goes up and over the ropes
walks around in his crease, then waits and opens the face to steer the quicker one straight to the fielder positioned at short third man
uses his feet and drives the full one down to long-on
suggests that he's about to dance down, then Hafeez bowls it wide outside off stump, Saha collects and whips off the bails but Marsh is back inside
gets across and works it away from off stump to midwicket
flat on the pads, he easily on-drives it to midwicket this time
too short outside off and he cuts past point and cover to sweeper
too full on the legs and he clips it out to midwicket
too short and Jayawardene pulls, making sure to roll the wrists, out to the man in the deep who easily fields it
short of a length outside leg stump, Marsh tucks it fine for a single
full toss outside off stump, Marsh reaches out and slaps it but Hafeez at backward point fields well to save a boundary
length ball outside leg, and Marsh doesn't time his nudge well at all
slow yorker outside off stump and Marsh misses out as he chases it

gone! Smart stuff from Saha! Fires it in flat outside off stump, Yuvraj goes for the late slash but misses and loses balance, Saha fumbles the ball and it rolls forward, but Yuvraj's back leg slides outside the line and Saha picks up the ball to break the stumps, it goes upstairs and the verdict is that Yuvraj just failed to drag the foot back over the line, a marginal call and it goes against the batsman
again too short and this time Yuvraj gets back and muscles that very flat over midwicket for another ferocious shot
short and he transfers the weight, cutting very hard to point where the ball slides right through the fielder's legs so thats the 50-run partnership in good time
but thats connected, Yuvraj skipping down and collecting the full toss with plenty of power for a big six over midwicket and Mohali goes mad
skips down and misses out on the flick, rapped on the pads instead
flighted on the stumps, he pushes it across the pads to midwicket
top shot, just driving square of the wicket with a flourish and picking the gap at square leg, ball races across the turf and meets the ropes
change of pace, Dinda pitching on a length and its defended back
bouncer, Marsh pulls and doesn't time it well and it goes much finer than expected, landing an inch outside the fine leg boundary
good length ball on off stump, Marsh is hurried into a push to point
good length just outside off and he punches it with a very straight bat between Marsh's legs and calls for the single, well timed
banged in short of off stump and it gets Yuvraj ducking and hopping
better length and Marsh mistimes the nudge back to Hafeez
flat on middle and leg and Yuvraj flicks it away past square leg
gets across and works this one to the man inside the ring
skips down and connects well, straight driving and Gul is sloppy down on the boundary, mistiming his dive
full and flat on the pads, he flicks it away nicely to get off the mark
dances down and drills the full one down to long-on for one
gets across again and manages the toe end of the bat on ball to place it to short fine leg, a plucky innings from Sangakkara so far
good length outside off, he gets across and drives nicely to cover

short one down leg stump, Sangakkara walks right across his stumps and tries to hook it away but misses and there's the thinnest of noises as ball brushes glove, Saha collects above his head and appeals with the bowler but the umpire, Sivaram, is unmoved so Sangakkara gets a life
close call, Sangakkara just saved by the inside-edge as he shapes to drive a fuller one straight down the ground, ball takes bat then thigh pad and runs fine
thats a wide, pitching full outside leg stump, Sanga misses the flick
very good take from Saha down the leg side, diving to pouch the ball after it brushes Sangakkara's thigh pad as he walks across and tries to flick it
stands his ground and opens the face, running it down past backward point, very late, and its placed excellently into the gap and beats a diving third man
chips this one from middle and leg, a real pick-up shot, and the ball drops just in front of the deep midwicket boundary, so Agarkar's woes continue
thats a streaky shot, as he flashes outside off stump and gets a thick edge over gully and down to third man, dropping before him
comes down and chips over mid-off, not timed very well but he's got enough bat on it to beat the man and the ball dribbles away for four
fullish again and this time he connects, driving to Ishant at mid-off
overpitched outside off stump, he drives hard but cannot connect
a bit short and he plays it to point for an easy single
good ball on off stump, he shuffles and works it to midwicket for one
top shot, just getting to the pitch of a good-length ball and creaming it on the up through the covers, great to watch
and he's gone, attempting another big shot over midwicket but the ball gains on him from a length and skies up into the evening for Hodge to run to his right from mid-on and hold it
better ball, a length on the stumps and Hopes, deep in his crease expecting a short one again, adjusts to tap it back to Dinda
crunching shot as Dinda gives Hopes room to free those solid forearms and he doesn't disappoint, slapping the ball through the covers
back of a length on the stumps, swings in and He plays with the movement to midwicket
short of a length outside leg stump, Marsh misses out on the tuck to leg and the ball parries away off the pads to backward point for a leg-bye
short of a length on off and going away, he opens the face and steers it away
well done, a yorker on off stump, Hopes jams bat down on ball just in the nick of time and scurries a single at Marsh's call as point is slow to run in
beaten on the expansive drive outside off stump as Ishant pitches full and looks for swing, ball beats bat narrowly and Saha collects behind the stumps
sweet shot! Fractionally short on middle and off and Hopes connects rather superbly with his flat-batted pull past midwicket, this is a top batting deck
makes room and tries to drive hard through the covers but uses too much bottom hand and ends up chopping to point
short ball on leg stump, Marsh gets tall and tucks it off the ribs for one
full on off stump, Marsh drives and gets a thick inside-edge back onto his front boot, Hopes calls for the quick single to point and they get it comfortably
fuller and straighter, Hopes on-drives to Gul at midwicket, who lets the ball go through his legs for a needless single, very sloppy stuff
short, he goes for a pull but misses as the ball gains on him
another slash off the front foot to a fuller one, this one played in front of square, where Hodge slides to his right and takes pace off the ball but cant stop it
and he's off the mark with a firm yet streaky carve backward of point, Hopes not trying to keep the ball along the ground, and it evades a leaping Brad Hodge
and he begins with one on middle and off, drawing a hard drive which takes the inside-edge and flies towards midwicket, who dives and saves runs
a tad fuller, on leg stump, and Marsh shapes to flick but ends up pushing it back in the air towards Hopes, who hops and lets the ball scoot by to mid-off
tight delivery on the stumps draws a hurried defensive from Marsh
that is a ripper! Ishant hits that sweet spot on off stump and gets the ball to seam and lift excellently to catch Marsh in all sorts of trouble, feeling and missing
thats runs, as Ishant pitches outside leg stump and allows Marsh to use the pace and help the ball along its way down to fine leg for four
good ball again, pitching on leg stump and going away from Marsh, who is nearly squared up but gets bat down on time, pushing it to point
good start, 137ks, back of a length and angling across Marsh, who checks his off stump and allows the ball to pass
swung away over square leg but that doesn't matter, as Punjab have clinched this match by nine runs to make it four in a row
and that will do it, as Saha misses a low full toss outside off stump
another near-yorker outside off stump, Agarkar tries to steer it fine but misses, Sangakkara dives to his right and fumbles it so they cross for a run
cant get it away, as Pathan bowls a yorker on off stump, driven to cover
well bowled, nearly a yorker, Saha hits it hard past midwicket and harries back for two, well run as the fielder was deep on that occasion
pitches on a length and Agarkar swings it to midwicket, so thats one
massive! Saha! Another big six over long-on, creamed off one knee

but this one's taken! Another slower ball from Gagandeep sucks Hussey out of his crease, he plays a repeat of the previous slog, which goes up into the starry evening for a long time but this time Hopes settles under it mid-off and takes it, then pumping his fists and letting out an almighty roar because Punjab know how important that wicket is
would you believe it? Gagandeep foxes Hussey with a clever slower ball, he slogs it up and up into the night but the ball drops smack between mid-on and mid-off after staying up there for an eternity
better ball, up there in the blockhole, Hussey carves past extra cover and sprints back excellently to collect two more, my this man can run, and well backed up by young Saha

miles, miles and gone! Hussey is not throwing it away, just sizing up the full toss and dispatching it rows back over long-on for maximum! This is a record stand between these two and its all happening in Mohali ... 100 and counting for Hussey and Saha
up there in the slot and its driven down the ground, the sweeper has ground to cover and collects to return in a poor throw so thats two to the total

oh good grief, Pathan has dropped a dolly! Hopes again gives Saha a slow full toss, which he drives down to deep mid-on where Pathan, running in from the ropes, pouches it but loses it to his right, then looking around as it pops up behind him and drop, my that was silly, and will Saha make it cost?
third six for Saha! Lovely clean hit, kneeling down and playing with the movement, heaving the slow off-cutter over deep midwicket
steps down leg stump and Hopes follows him with the full ball, which Hussey drives in the air down to long-off, who fields on the bounce
he's smoked that! Hopes serves up another full toss and Hussey swings it away over cow corner for a good hit, rows back over the boundary
full again, he looks to go over midwicket with his swipe but gets a leading-edge over the bowler which drops safely in no man's land
full on the stumps and he on-drives down to the sweeper, running hard
full in the blockhole and Saha can only drive it hard to long-on
slashes over point, the ball drops in front of Goel and Saha gets two
steps across and pulls from outside off stump, hit with too much bottom hand but its wide of mid-on and Hussey sprints back to get the second, to the danger end
low full toss, he makes room and clubs it towards mid-on
full again, this time he nudges the ball past the off-side circle
gets some room and pushes the ball to Goel at sweeper-cover, who fumbles
there's his fifty, nudging a full ball out to Pathan at deep midwicket
an agricultural slog across the line, the ball dribbling into the gap at leg
another big shot, as he uses his feet and swings it over mid-on, Pathan leaps back with one hand but the ball goes over his head, another clinical shot
full down leg stump, he gets a bit of bat on it and clips to fine leg
how did that miss? Hussey steps out and swings across the line and the off-cutter somehow goes over the top of middle and leg
good length on the stumps, slower ball, played back to Hopes
more runs, as he sizes up Chawla and swings him flat over midwicket, another good shot and Saha is now looking to get on with matters against Chawla
short outside off, he gets back and cuts but cannot beat cover

dropped, but very tough! A big slog this time, over deep mid-on, stays up in the air for ages and comes down to Jayawardene right on the ropes, who leaps back and gets fingertips on it but fails to keep going and the momentum pushes him back over the ropes
short again, this time no turn, and he cuts hard to Yuvraj at cover
too short and Saha picks the flipper, getting back and pulling past midwicket for a single, but where are the boundaries?
spun up on middle and leg, Saha gets across and sweeps it away
slower ball, Hussey waits and opens the face to play it backward point
gets tall and punches this one along the ground to backward point
full on middle and leg, another nice-looking flick past midwicket
full on the pads and thats turned to Gagandeep at backward square
slower ball, pushed uppishly to Yuvraj at cover, who collects and shies at the stumps but misses so Saha gets across safely
good length outside off and Saha steers it right to backward point
gets some room but cuts along the ground to short third man
big hit! Hussey says snuff is snuff, clears the front leg, and tees off for six over long-on to spark tunes of Korbo, lorbo jeetbo re from the PA system
better ball, back of a length and Hussey dabs it wide of backward point, who collects and returns to the nonstriker's end, where Gagandeep fails to back up
low full toss allows him to club it back dead straight, just evading Gagandeep's fingertips and the stumps, and neither long-off nor long-on had a chance
just errs in length and Hussey, skipping down the track, swings him over midwicket for a boundary, well struck shot from the Aussie veteran
comes onto the front foot to push the ball nicely to extra cover
back of a length and this one's gently tapped to point for a single
there it is again, and Saha pushes to a diving cover fielder
full on middle and off and Saha can only drive that right to cover
another near yorker but this time Hussey uses his feet and drives to long-off for a single
well bowled, nearly a yorker, and Hussey digs it back to VRV
frees the arms and swings the length ball over mid-on, Kolkata need many more of those if  they want to chase this daunting target down
comes onto the front foot and drives, but the bat twirls in his hand and he gets a run to square leg instead, urged by Saha
a tad overpitched on leg, he flicks nicely to a diving midwicket
pitches on leg, he shapes to flick and gets a thin inside-edge onto the pad, Saha calls for the single and they scamper across as square leg fields
again there's no room and Saha just tucks it to midwicket
accurate bowling, on off stump and Saha can only defend
on leg stump and he clips it just wide of midwicket for one
gets back and cuts the ball late and into the gap wide of Marsh
welcomed with a short one and he rides the bounce to play it down into the gap just wide of Marsh at backward point and he's away
middle stump is pegged back as Shukla makes room and fails to connect
down the pads and he tucks it away for one to raise the fifty
skips down to try and break the shackles, getting it just off the end of the bat but its over cover and point and lands safely for a boundary
frees the arms and steers the short one past Marsh at point, Yuvraj has men positioned well on the off side and third man swoops in
beaten as he makes room and tries to steer it past gully
wrong line and this is worked off the pads to square leg
slower ball, Shukla gets across and on-drives to mid-on
too straight and he works it across the line to midwicket for one
sees some room and goes to cut, dragging it down to Marsh
nearly squares him up but he plays it gently to Marsh at point
slashes off the front foot, slicing the ball wide of Marsh again, who gets a hand on the ball to take some pace off it but Hussey picks up a single
more room on offer and this time he cuts into the gap at cover for two
well stopped there! VRV offers width and Hussey carves it late to backward point, where Marsh dives to his left and saves what seemed a certain four
another aggressive shot, dragged from outside off stump past midwicket, where Pathan sprints in from the boundary to cut off any thoughts of a second
no footwork as Shukla chips this off the back foot over cover, the ball is in the air for a while but lands safely in the deep and the batsmen cross for two
tries to drive off the back foot but ends up chopping into the ground in front of point, he has a look up at the other end and Shukla says yes, mate
back of a length, Shukla gets up and drops the ball to Marsh at point
tad too full and he eases a front-foot drive out to Hopes at deep cover
slower ball, slipping into Hussey, who comes forward and defends
thats a nothing drive from the crease, away from the body, and the ball slices through the gap at gully and rolls down to the fielder at third man
change of pace, back of a length, driven off the back foot but the late movement draws a faulty shot, they run one for the inside-edge to midwicket
back of a length on leg stump and he works it away to midwicket
dangerous leave there, as Hussey doesn't get his front foot out that far before shouldering arms and the ball just skims over the top of middle and off
back of a length on middle stump and he defends it back to Pathan
change of pace, pushing it away from Hussey, who shoulders arms
wide outside off stump, shorter length, Hussey leaves it be
more movement, again pitching on leg and swinging in, Hussey is late on the stroke but survives with an inside-edge, Pathan is on fire tonight
gets across and drops this shorter one into the gap at gully for one
another close call! Pitches on leg and swings down to rap a clueless Shukla, rooted to his crease, but this time the umpire shakes his head after a thought, and its really swinging around out there

and he gets his man soon after the reprieve! Das doesn't move his feet as he attempts a slog over extra cover and the top-edge spirals up and settles in Yuvraj's palms at mid-off to spark a highly enthused reaction from Sreesanth
another hard-handed drive, but past Hussey and down to mid-on
thumped! This time Das connects on the full one and drills this past Sreesanth

close call, the ball swinging in late from just outside off stump to rap Das' front pad as he shapes to drive, Sreesanth asks the question but the umpire doesn't budge, replays show the ball swinging in and clipping the top of middle and leg, so Sreesanth is morfified
back of a length on off stump, he nervously comes forward and defends
good length outside off, swinging away, and he holds back on the shot

nailed him! Pathan pitches full just around and about off stump, bringing the ball back in and rapping Hodge on the front foot, late on the stroke, and a throaty appeal is upheld by the umpire after a thought, and it looked, to the naked eye, to be hitting him in line with middle and off
back of a length this time and he squeezes it past point for a single
full just outside off stump and thats a firm punch straight to extra cover
back of a length, nips into Hodge but he gets tall and pushes it down with soft hands before scampering across for a quick single
good length outside off stump, pushed to cover off the front foot

timber! Hafeez loses his marbles, skipping down and slogging across the line with his eyes shut, looking to heave this over midwicket but the ugly stroke fails to connect and ball makes contact to rearrange the furniture, Pathan is mobbed by his team-mates
good length on off stump, he flicks it with a thick inside-edge to square leg and sets off at the nonstriker's insistence and some good runnings gets him one
gone! Ganguly gets back and uppercuts a pretty short ball outside off stump right down Pathan's throat at third man, positioning himself to pouch it just inside the boundary
tries another drive but inside-edges to leg due to the change of pace
full and he goes for a booming drive, mistiming it in the air over backward point and the elevation helps the ball dribble across the boundary ropes
short of a length, no room, and he taps it down into the ground
short ball sits up but Ganguly gets tall on the toes and runs it down into the gap backward of square for a single out to deep point
short of a length outside off, he pushes to point but cant get one
marginally outside leg stump, swings down and raps the pads
hello, dolly! A touch short but Hafeez swivels on one leg excellently, swinging the ball over deep backward square leg for half a dozen, top stuff there
pitches outside leg stump, he again tries to tuck it away but misses out, ball clips pad and runs fine
pitches on leg stump, Hafeez mistimes his attempted nudge, Pathan appeals but the umpire is unmoved, may have been missing due to the bounce
lands on a good length and Hafeez drives off the front foot to mid-off
back of a length and going away from Ganguly, who pushes and misses
on the pads, tucked away but again some rubbish calling sees them turn down what appeared an easy single

better length and Ganguly comes forward to push the ball to extra cover, there's some miscommunication with Hafeez, who sends him back even though Ganguly is halfway down the track, he has to turn and make it back and because the fielders were slow to react he survives
too wide and Ganguly squeezes it over a leaping backward point, this outfield is lighting fast and so third man cannot get across to stop the ball
too full outside leg stump and too much swing away from a diving Sangakkara so thats five freebies to Kolkata's account
pitches on a good length outside off, Ganguly is beaten trying to steer
back of a length on off stump and Hafeez gets across to tuck it away
